chapter: Glaser, the Arcadia and bands of 1939-41
title: Kelly's Stables
summary: Roy led a small group at Kelly's Stables for several months, then Glaser sent him to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah, I went into Kelly's [Stables] with a small group. Joe Turner worked in there with me, too. We worked in there. And I worked in there with Billy for nine months...or four months or something. We worked there a long...I don't know exactly how long. But it was the only time that any owner ever gave the band a party, we stayed in there so long, you know, doing this good business for him. [April-October, 1940]
Then I went out to Chicago. Glaser sent me out to Chicago. Then it was pushing on to '41, and I went to the Capitol Lounge.
